text: An n-connected type A (in HoTT) satisfies:
choices: πₖ(A)=0 for k≤n (all homotopy groups through n are trivial)
A has exactly n connected components
all paths in A are loops
explanation: A is n-connected iff it is n-truncated after one truncation: ∥A∥_n is contractible. Equivalently, πₖ(A)=0 for k≤n. 0-connected = path-connected; 1-connected = simply connected.
